tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Find Grok Bot templates by job. Returns slug, name, tagline, category, required plugins and usage level. Leave query empty to list all.

tools.name: install_template
tools.description: Get step-by-step install instructions for one template. target "this_bot" (default) adds its skills, rules and paused routines to the current Bot without replacing its role; "new_bot" returns the setup prompt to paste as the first message of a new Bot.

tools.name: install_bundle
tools.description: Install a kit of templates for one role into this Bot in one go. Bundles: founder (Founder kit: morning brief, competitors, leads and a weekly chief of staff); creator (Creator kit: repurpose posts, draft X posts, track your niche, tighten drafts); researcher (Research kit: check claims, audit sourc

tools.name: my_templates
tools.description: List the templates this Boterly account has installed, which have a newer version, and the plan and installs left. Reinstall a template with install_template to update it.

tools.name: diagnose_problem
tools.description: Look up sourced fixes for a Grok Bot problem, e.g. "routine not running", "skills missing after import", "plugin will not connect", "uses too much usage".

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: install_template, install_bundle · Public sink: install_bundle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: install_template, install_bundle · Public sink: install_bundle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
